title: Run the final local release-candidate acceptance gate
objective: Bind source, real Chromium, real loopback HTTP, export, restart persistence and full-repository checks to one pre-release candidate, and report remaining Go/No-Go boundaries without claiming field accuracy or deployment.
approval_ref: The user explicitly requested final testing before product release and asked what else must be considered.
notes: Use isolated synthetic data for browser and loopback tests; do not read customer credentials or mutate the customer database.
Retain red evidence when a stale smoke assertion or product defect is found.
A green local gate does not override the fixed live answer-quality threshold, QA V2 input-limit blocker, fresh-install, migration, DPAPI, packaging, CI or deployment boundaries.
